Service

Crocodile Spotting & Safety Overwatch

Trained operators watch the water and banks so crews can work near croc habitat with eyes on every threat.

The Northern Territory’s crocodile population has recovered strongly — a great conservation success, but more chance of human–crocodile encounters for crews in remote areas and on waterways. Our safety overwatch operators keep dedicated, uninterrupted eyes on the water and banks while your crew focuses on the job, with clear stop-work authority and communication protocols agreed before work starts. Armed safety overwatch is available where the risk requires it.

What’s included

  • Dedicated spotters positioned for clear sight lines over water and banks
  • Pre-start briefings on crocodile behaviour, warning signs and site rules
  • Agreed alert, stop-work and evacuation protocols with your supervisors
  • Day and night spotting, including spotlight surveys for eyeshine
  • Monitoring of tides, water levels and conditions that change the risk
  • Daily observation logs for your HSE records

When you need it

Geotechnical drilling, survey or sampling at or near water

Bridge, culvert, causeway, wharf and boat-ramp construction or maintenance

Pipeline, cable and dredging works crossing rivers, creeks and floodplains

Environmental monitoring, water sampling and field research

How it works

A shift on overwatch

  1. 1Brief

    Pre-start briefing on site rules and signals.

  2. 2Position

    Spotters placed for clear sight lines.

  3. 3Scan & log

    Continuous watch of water and banks, logged.

  4. 4Alert

    Stop-work call the moment a threat appears.

  5. 5Resume

    Work restarts only when the area is clear.

Questions

Why not just have a crew member keep watch?

A spotter who is also doing their own job is not watching the water. Dedicated, trained overwatch removes that distraction and brings experience in reading crocodile behaviour and habitat.

Do you work at night?

Yes. Crocodiles are often most active after dark, and spotlight surveys for eyeshine are a standard part of night-time overwatch.

Can you work on remote sites?

Yes. We service projects across the Northern Territory, Western Australia and Queensland, including remote and fly-in sites.
